products.body_html:
Imperial Green Jadeite Pendant Necklace Collection

Overview
Indulge in the timeless elegance of this exquisite Imperial Green Jadeite Pendant Collection. Each piece features a premium, vibrant green jadeite cabochon, meticulously selected for its intense color saturation, rich translucency, and flawless, velvety smooth finish. Symbolizing wealth, longevity, and good fortune, these heirloom-quality necklaces blend traditional cultural heritage with modern luxury, making them perfect for both formal events and upscale daily wear.

Design Options Available

1. The Auspicious Calabash Pendant
- Symbolism: Represents infinite blessings, good fortune, and protection.
- Craftsmanship: Features a plump, voluptuous double-tier gourd carved from translucent green jadeite.
- Accents: Available in a classic variant with a minimalist white gold bail adorned with a single diamond accent, or a luxury variant entirely framed in a shimmering pavé diamond halo setting.

2. The Classic Safety Coin Pendant
- Symbolism: A timeless talisman signifying safety, peace, and domestic harmony.
- Craftsmanship: A perfectly balanced, circular green jadeite disc with a polished hole at its center.
- Accents: Anchored by a central sparkling diamond accent point and suspended from a delicate, finely crafted white gold chain.

3 Stromversorgungsmethoden: Sind Sie immer noch wütend, dass Ihre elektronische Laterne spät in der Nacht draußen ausgeschaltet ist? Vergessen Sie es, unsere Outdoor Solar Camping Laterne perfekt das Problem gelöst. Es ist vielseitig für 3 Stromversorgungsmethoden, Solarladen, Handkurbeldynamo-Laden und USB-Laden (USB-Ladekabel enthalten). Es kann auch als Notstrombank verwendet werden, wodurch Ihr iPhone vorübergehend geladen werden können. Du wirst niemals Angst haben, draußen isoliert zu sein.

Ultra Bright und Super Long Standby: Unsere Solarlaterne ist mit 200 Lumen hell genug. Die eingebauten wiederaufladbaren Batterien haben eine super lange Lebensdauer. Machen Sie sich keine Mühe, die Batterie häufig zu ersetzen, was wirtschaftlich und umweltfreundlich ist. Stecken Sie den Adapter (5v / 2A) in einen Standardstecker an und schließen Sie dann den Steckdose "micro USB-Schnittstelle" auf der Breite an, um den Akku aufzuladen. Wenn der Akku voll geladen ist, kann das Hauptlicht nicht weniger als 35 Stunden lang kontinuierlich eingeschaltet sein.

Einzigartiges zusammenklappbares Design und einfach zu bedienen: Unsere Laterne wird durch die zusammenklappbare Struktur gesteuert, mit der Sie die Helligkeit ändern können, indem Sie die Höhe der Laterne einstellen. Sie können den oberen Teil nach oben ziehen oder nach unten schieben, um die Laterne an oder aus zu halten, sehr einfach zu bedienen. Nach dem Falten kann das Unterlicht nach Drücken des mittleren Knopfes auch als Taschenlampe verwendet werden. Die Griffe werden verwendet, um die Laterne an einem Baum oder einem Zelt zu hängen, um Ihre Umgebung zu beleuchten.

Superior Materialien und IPX4 wasserdicht: Unsere Solar-Handkurbel Wanderlaterne nimmt Qualitäts-ABS-Kunststoffmaterial, langlebig und praktisch an. IPX4 Wasserbeständigkeit bedeutet, dass die Laterne unter Spritzen von Wassertropfen aus allen Winkeln sicher ist. Bitte beachten Sie jedoch, dass es nicht direkt starkem Regen oder Schnee ausgesetzt wird, um seine Lebensdauer zu erhalten.

Die Größe beträgt 10,6 * 7,4 * 3,19 Zoll. Gewicht: 300g. Mit süßem Design und schicker Farbe werden Sie es auf jeden Fall lieben.

Leicht und tragbar: Unsere Handkurbellanterne hat ein überlegenes zusammenklappbares Design, wodurch sie einfach gefaltet und gelagert wird. Leicht und kompakt, können Sie es in Ihren Rucksack, große Tasche oder Notfallkit setzen, ideal für Outdoor-Aktivitäten, Wandern, Camping, Angeln, Autowartung oder Ausschalten.

products.title: GlowScent Smart Hair & Scalp Care Comb
products.body_html:
GlowScent – Smart Hair & Scalp Care Comb

GlowScent is an innovative daily hair and scalp care device that combines hair care, hydration, protection, fine mist application, vibration massage, and red LED light therapy in one easy-to-use experience.

Designed to become part of your daily hair-care routine, GlowScent allows you to choose the liquid that best suits your hair-care needs and distribute it as a fine mist while brushing.

 Three Care Formulas

GlowScent comes with 3 refillable capsules and 3 specially formulated liquids, each designed for a different part of your hair-care routine:

 Smooth Shield

Designed to be part of your daily hair-care and protection routine, helping leave hair feeling smoother and easier to manage.

 Hydration Touch

Designed to provide your hair with a hydrated, refreshed feel, making it suitable for everyday hair-care routines.

 Pure Scent

Designed to give your hair a fresh, pleasant fragrance while remaining part of your overall hair-care experience—not simply a traditional perfume.

Choose the capsule and formula that best fits your hair and your daily routine.

Refillable Capsules

GlowScent capsules are designed to be refilled and reused with the specially formulated GlowScent liquids.

How to Refill the Capsule

  1. Remove the capsule from the device.
  2. The capsule will be empty and sealed with a rubber stopper.
  3. Carefully remove the stopper.
  4. Take the GlowScent liquid you want to use.
  5. Fill the capsule with the amount of liquid you need.
  6. Securely replace the stopper.
  7. Insert the capsule back into the GlowScent device.
  8. The device is now ready to use.

Important: Do not use other liquids, perfumes, or formulas in the capsules. Only use the specially formulated GlowScent liquids to ensure proper compatibility with the device and mist system.

How to Operate GlowScent

GlowScent is designed for simple one-touch control.

First Press

Turns the device on and activates Red LED Light Mode.

Second Press

Switches to Light Mist Mode.

Third Press

Switches to Stronger Mist Mode.

Long Press

Turns the device off.

You can easily switch between modes during your hair-care routine.

Red LED Light

GlowScent features an integrated red LED light system designed to be part of your daily hair and scalp care routine.

Use the red LED mode while gently moving the device through your hair and across the scalp.

Vibration Scalp Massage

GlowScent features a built-in vibration massage function designed to provide a comfortable and relaxing scalp-care experience while brushing.

Massage Controls

One touch on the top of the device:
Turns the massage on.

One more touch:
Turns the massage off.

Long touch:
Adjusts the vibration intensity higher or lower according to your preference.

Choose the vibration level that feels most comfortable while gently moving the device across your scalp.

Hair Care + Fine Mist in One Step

Instead of manually applying your hair-care formula, GlowScent allows you to distribute the selected liquid as a fine mist while brushing your hair.

Use:

Smooth Shield for protection and care
Hydration Touch for hydration and refreshment
Pure Scent for hair care with a fresh fragrance

This allows you to combine hair care, hydration, protection, and freshness into one simple daily routine.

1000mAh Rechargeable Battery

GlowScent is equipped with a 1000mAh rechargeable lithium battery.

With moderate use, one full charge can last for up to one month when the device is used for approximately 5 minutes per day.

The device uses USB Type-C charging.

What’s Included

  • 1 × GlowScent Smart Hair & Scalp Care Comb
  • 1 × Charging Base
  • 3 × Refillable Capsules
  • 1 × Smooth Shield Formula
  • 1 × Hydration Touch Formula
  • 1 × Pure Scent Formula
  • 1 × USB Type-C Charging Cable

Your Daily GlowScent Routine

Choose your formula → Fill the capsule → Insert the capsule → Turn on the device → Select your mist level → Brush through your hair and scalp → Activate the massage when needed → Enjoy your complete hair-care routine.

GlowScent

Care. Protect. Hydrate. Refresh.

products.title: Cat Muzzle With Cute Cat Ears, Breathable Mesh Cat Hood For Grooming, Anti-Bite Anti-Scratch Cat Face Cover, Adjustable Drawstring Cat Neck Cover For Nail Trimming, Bathing & Vet Visits
products.body_html:
Five Features

NO MORE BITES OR SCRATCHES Trim nails, clean ears, give pills — without getting clawed. The mesh hood keeps teeth and claws away from your hands. Grooming stops being a wrestling match.

YOUR CAT CAN STILL SEE The wide front opening leaves both eyes clear. Your cat doesn't feel blindfolded, so it panics far less. Calmer cat, faster job.

BREATHABLE MESH, NOT A SAUNA The mesh body lets air move through, so it stays cool even in summer. Light enough that most cats forget they have it on.

ONE PULL, STAYS PUT A single drawstring with a toggle lock adjusts to any neck size. It won't slip off or get pawed away halfway through.

CUTE CAT-EARS, EASY TO WASH The little ears make it look like a hat, not a muzzle. Hand wash in cool water and air dry — ready for the next bath day.

Description

Bath time shouldn't end with scratched arms.

This is a soft mesh hood that covers your cat's mouth and neck — the two spots that do the damage. The front stays open so your cat can see everything. That's what keeps it calm.

The fabric is light and airy. No sweating, no heavy plastic cone. The drawstring tightens with one hand and locks in place, so it won't slide off while you work.

Cute cat ears on top. Because a scared cat in a scary-looking mask makes everything worse.

How to use Slide it over the head, pull the drawstring snug, and leave two fingers of room under the neck. Take it off as soon as you're done. Never leave it on an unattended cat.

Wash & care Hand wash in cool water with mild soap. Air dry flat. Do not bleach, do not tumble dry.

Where it fits into your week Nail trims at home. Ear cleaning and meds. Bath time and blow drying. Vet visits and travel carriers.

Sizes S — small cats, up to about 8 lb / 3.5 kg M — average to large cats, 8–15 lb / 3.5–7 kg

Measure around the neck and add one finger of slack. When in doubt, size up.

Use it at home, at the vet, on the road.
